title: Existing-patient reschedule request becomes a reception task
description: The caller already has a visit and provides complete synthetic identity details in the first turn. For latency, the assistant may create the reception task immediately on that first turn instead of inserting a separate phone-confirmation turn. The flow should remain in the reception-task branch only.

turns.user: Dzien dobry, chce przelozyc istniejaca wizyte. Mam na imie Jan Test Handoff, moj numer to siedem zero dwa, zero zero trzy, zero zero piec.

assertions.description: The assistant should not enter direct scheduling for a reschedule request.
assertions.root_cause_hint: assistant left the handoff branch and tried to schedule directly

rubric.description: With complete identity data in the first turn, the assistant should create the reception task immediately.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant added an avoidable confirmation turn instead of using the clear first-turn identity data

rubric.description: The assistant should create a reception task for the reschedule request.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant prompt or createReceptionTask workflow no longer supports the reschedule branch

rubric.description: The handoff must use the reschedule_or_cancel task type.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is creating the wrong follow-up task type for reschedule requests

rubric.description: The handoff payload must not include a free-text summary field.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is still sending free-text summary data in createReceptionTask

rubric.description: The handoff payload must not include a free-text notes field.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is still sending free-text notes in createReceptionTask

rubric.description: A reschedule request must not create a new calendar event.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant attempted to book instead of handing the case to reception
